ASYMPTOTIC BEHAVIORS OF THE COLORED JONES
POLYNOMIALS OF A TORUS KNOT
HITOSHI MURAKAMI
Abstract. We study the asymptotic behaviors of the colored Jones polyno-
mials of torus knots. Contrary to the works by R. Kashaev, O. Tirkkonen,
Y. Yokota, and the author, they do not seem to give the volumes or the
Chern–Simons invariants of the three-manifolds obtained by Dehn surgeries.
On the other hand it is proved that in some cases the limits give the inverse
of the Alexander polynomial.
